description: This file contains instructions for using GitHub Copilot in the project.
applyTo: **
---

# Do not
- Do not add changes description in the root README.md, the root README.md is for overview and architecture and some development setup doc. Not for changes made.
- Do not add changes description in other markdown files, use a dedicated CHANGELOG.md for documenting changes.
- For configuration-only fixes, validate the configuration directly instead of adding feature regression tests that merely re-test external service behavior, such as MongoDB authentication. New regression tests must cover the application's intended behavior, not just infrastructure settings.
